links.outcome: Physician-reported barrier of insufficient AI training and knowledge of AI concepts
links.effect: Insufficient training was the most frequently reported barrier (58.9%); only 50.3% demonstrated good knowledge of AI concepts and applications.
links.quote: The most frequently reported barriers were insufficient training (58.9%) and lack of trust in AI systems (53.8%).

screen.reason: Multicenter cross-sectional survey evaluating physician readiness, knowledge, attitudes, and perceived barriers regarding AI adoption in clinical screening and diagnosis.
